hero.title: Choose your door.
hero.sub: Synapse has five entry doors. Tell us who you are and what you need; the owner phones back personally to discuss next steps.
hero.strip: Monday to Saturday, 3:30 PM to 6:30 PM · Behind the Post Office, Chamba

notices.under18: For students under 18, a parent or guardian must provide contact details.
notices.fees: Fees are shared when you enquire.

doors.title: A parent or student
doors.summary: Small-group classes, foundational reasoning, and daily practice tests. Or take the short entrance baseline diagnostic.

interestOptions.label: PCM (JEE Main/Advanced, IAT, NEST, CUET PCM, NDA)
PCB (NEET UG, AIIMS Nursing, Paramedical, CUET PCB)

doors.doorNote: Small groups, five days a week per student. Fees are shared when you enquire.

doors.title: A graduate who wants to teach
doors.summary: Teach one class a day while preparing for your own examination. Receive a reserved library desk, certified teaching hours, and the tutor.
doors.subjectPlaceholder: e.g. Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry, Biology, Reasoning
doors.examPlaceholder: e.g. UPSC, State PSC, GATE, NET, SSC
doors.doorNote: Applications are open now. Each fellow teaches one class a day.

doors.title: A reader
doors.summary: Access the quiet desks, reference collections, and reading rooms of the Knowledge Commons when reader cards open.
doors.interestPlaceholder: Subjects, research, or books you study
doors.cardOptionLabel: Notify me as soon as reader cards are released in Chamba
doors.doorNote: The Knowledge Commons library opens next, when people will buy the card.

doors.title: A founder or builder
doors.summary: Desks and community on the top floor in return for mentoring and teaching children. Agreed per founder.
doors.projectPlaceholder: Describe your project, software, hardware, or craft
doors.mentorPlaceholder: Topics or skills you can share with children
doors.doorNote: Venture Hub space opens only when there are real founders. Mentoring commitment is agreed per founder.

doors.title: A district partner
doors.summary: Bring a Synapse Circle to your district. Each centre rooted in its district with local space and community.
doors.spacePlaceholder: Describe your space, building, or local team
doors.doorNote: Each centre is rooted in its district with local space. Growth only from revenue.
